mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and aminoglycosides are ototoxic; concurrent use increases risk of acute kidney injury and auditory/vestibular toxicity, particularly when aminoglycosides penetrate renal tubules.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and urinalysis regularly; consider therapeutic drug monitoring for amikacin; ensure adequate hydration and assess for signs of ototoxicity; evaluate necessity of combination therapy.
